# Guitar Coach FE — agent guide

Expo SDK 57 / React Native 0.86 / React 19.2 / Expo Router 57 / TypeScript 6.

## Expo HAS CHANGED

Read the exact versioned docs at https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/ before writing any
code. Do not rely on training data for Expo, Expo Router, or React Native APIs — this stack
is newer than most of it. Verify before you write, and say so when you couldn't verify.

## Never hand-edit generated files

| File                 | Generated by                                            | Rule                                       |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `src/types/api.d.ts` | `npm run api:types` (from the backend's OpenAPI schema) | Regenerate; never edit. CI diff-checks it. |
| `expo-env.d.ts`      | `expo start` (Expo CLI)                                 | Gitignored by design. Never commit.        |
| `.expo/types/`       | `expo start` (expo-router typegen)                      | Gitignored by design. Never commit.        |

`src/types/*.ts` (`task.ts`, `routine.ts`, …) are thin re-exports of `api.d.ts` — e.g.
`export type Task = components['schemas']['TaskResponseDto']`. To model a new backend
shape, re-export it; don't hand-write a parallel type, or it will drift silently.

**API changes are backend-first.** The frontend's CI reads the backend repo's `main`
branch, so a backend change must be merged there before the frontend PR can pass. Full
command-by-command flow: [`docs/api-contract-workflow.md`](docs/api-contract-workflow.md).

## Verifying your work

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit      # no `typecheck` script exists; run the compiler directly
npx expo lint
npx prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
```

Known pre-existing failures — **not yours, don't "fix" them opportunistically**:

- `src/hooks/use-color-scheme.web.ts` — one `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` lint error.
- `src/components/error-boundary-fallback.tsx` is not Prettier-clean. Format only files you
  actually touch.

`tsc --noEmit` should be **0 errors**. Typed routes only resolve when `.expo/types` exists
locally (i.e. after `expo start`); a clean checkout that never ran the dev server will not
type-check routes at all.

## Layout and conventions

```
src/app/        expo-router routes: (auth) and (app)/(main)/(tabs)
src/api/        <resource>.ts = transport; <resource>.queries.ts = TanStack Query hooks
src/features/   screen-level composition, one folder per feature
src/components/ ui/ = 17 shared primitives; nav/ = navigation chrome
src/stores/     app-wide Zustand state (session, toast)
src/lib/        storage, date-grouping, duration, file-validation
src/theme/      Organic design tokens
src/types/      generated api.d.ts + per-resource re-exports
```

- Route groups matter: the real path is `/(app)/(main)/(tabs)/routines`, not
  `/(app)/(tabs)/routines`. Detail routes resolve bare: `/routines/[id]`.
- Components consume `*.queries.ts` hooks; don't call `useQuery` with an inline key from a
  feature file (it splits the cache). Keys live in `src/api/query-keys.ts`.
- Styling is `StyleSheet.create` over `src/theme/tokens.ts`. No NativeWind — see
  `plan/ARCHITECTURE-HANDOFF.md` §4 before proposing one.

## Platform gotchas

- **Use `src/lib/storage.ts` (MMKV) for persistence, not `expo-secure-store`.** SecureStore
  has no web implementation and throws at runtime on web. MMKV's `createMMKV` resolves to a
  native instance or a `localStorage` shim automatically. (`expo-secure-store` remains a
  config plugin in `app.config.ts` but is unused in `src/` — safe to remove.)
- `react-native-mmkv` needs a dev client; it does not run in Expo Go.
- `.npmrc` sets `legacy-peer-deps=true` — `openapi-typescript` still declares a
  `typescript@^5.x` peer while this repo is on 6.0. Removing it breaks `npm ci`.
- `tsconfig.json` excludes `backend/`, which CI checks the backend repo out into. Keep it.

## Backend constraints that are easy to break

Verified against the committed OpenAPI schema:

- **Practice sessions are write-once.** `/practice-sessions/{sessionId}` is `GET` only —
  no update endpoint. Starting practice creates nothing; the session is written once, on
  Finish. Local in-progress state lives in `src/features/session/session-store.ts`.
- **Session totals are client-derived.** There is no total-elapsed field and no analytics
  endpoint; per-task minutes are optional, so every total is a client-side sum that must
  render correctly when minutes are absent.
- **Tasks are read-only for ordinary users** — write routes are admin-gated.
- **The two AI modes are separate endpoints.** Draft & Review persists nothing until
  confirmed; Instant Create persists on success.
- Auth is a better-auth httpOnly cookie. `src/stores/session-store.ts` only caches the
  last-known user for an instant boot gate — it is not the credential.
